methods.overlay: Shapely/GEOS double-precision intersection of original straight lon/lat polygon segments and nearest-centre axis partition rectangles; no snapping or repair.
methods.grid_ties: Point matches retain original axis order through numpy.argmin. Closed polygon partitions may share zero-area boundaries.
methods.area: Each factory uses a WGS84 local Lambert Azimuthal Equal Area projection centred on its bbox midpoint. Project densified original lon/lat segments; area is in square metres.
methods.centroid: Area centroid of locally projected densified polygon; may be outside a concave polygon and is then explicitly marked.
methods.point_on_surface: Shapely representative_point of locally projected polygon, inverse-transformed and checked against original polygon.
methods.largest_overlap: Largest positive polygon intersection area; exact ties ordered by grid latitude/longitude. Grid scenario, not a factory point.
methods.mask: Rejected area fraction is retained, never renormalized onto valid land cells; no area-weighted factory HI or exposure is computed.
methods.primary_result: Accepted primary point, grid and missing metrics unchanged; comparisons against a masked primary remain null.
methods.area_interpretation: Fractions describe mapped polygon geometry within nearest-centre regions, not worker distribution, land-surface fraction, site exposure, or positional confidence.

isolated_dependency_wheel.installation: pip --no-deps --target in external task artifact directory; main environment unchanged
